title: Astronaut Bones Can Lose 30% Before A Mars Return
hook: A Mars mission can cost astronauts 30% of hip-bone density.
closing: Exercise is not optional when spaceflight steadily weakens the skeleton carrying you home.
question: Would you still go to Mars?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can drop 1.5% monthly, compressing years of Earth-side weakening into weeks.
Hip density can fall 2.2% monthly because weight-bearing bones lose their normal workload.
An unprotected Mars mission could cost 30% of hip density, making countermeasures essential for survival.
